# TodoMVC Fixture Project

This is a runnable React/Vite starter fixture for evaluating Builder Agent implementation.

It is intentionally separate from the Hooky repository. During eval, this folder is copied into each model-specific working folder.

The fixture supplies a coherent project shell plus approved tests. It is not a completed TodoMVC implementation. The Builder Agent should replace the placeholder app behavior with a normal TodoMVC implementation that satisfies the approved tests.
